structure.unit: Medical Malpractice Review Panels; Arbitration of Malpractice Claims

law.catch_line: When hearing to be held; notice to parties
law.text: The plaintiff or defendant may request the medical review panel to hold a hearing on any claim referred to the medical review panel, in which case the medical review panel shall conduct a hearing thereon in accordance with § 8.01-581.6 after notice to the parties by means adequate to ensure their presence at the time and place of the hearing.
